## Boundary checklist

This is a public repository. Tick each line or explain below why it does not apply.

- [ ] No secret values, tokens, client-id literals or credentials anywhere in the diff, the PR body or CI logs.
- [ ] No cluster topology: no node names, IP addresses, hardware, tunnel ids or private runbook content.
- [ ] No people's names or personal contact details beyond the public maintainer handles.
- [ ] Ecosystem seams are consumed, not rebuilt (identity, billing, LLMs, OCR, messaging, deploy).
- [ ] Interface contracts in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` are unchanged, or this PR adds an ADR in `docs/adr/`.
- [ ] `docs/HONEST_STATUS.md` still tells the truth after this change.

## Synthetic data

- [ ] Every person, family, place, date, photo and document in fixtures, seeds, tests, screenshots and docs is synthetic
      (generated by `python -m family_history.cli seed-synth` or drawn from the synthetic lexicon). No CURP, RFC,
      real phone number or real email address.

## Tests

- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests, and the CI jobs that cover the touched paths are green.
- [ ] Manifests, workflows or scripts changed: `scripts/` self-tests and the `manifests` job pass locally or in CI.
